weeklySchedule.layout: Ordered chronological agenda; date rail; 20px serif session titles, 22px from 640px; shorter rest rows; separate 44px completion controls.
weeklySchedule.dataEncoding: 4px primary bars compare prescribed non-rest minutes against the longest prescribed non-rest session in the displayed week. Explicit minute labels and a legend remain visible. Planned total excludes rest and does not change with manual completion or recorded metrics.
weeklySchedule.semantics: Native ordered list. Detail controls describe modality, planned time and status, with an execution score only when supported. Closing content becomes aria-hidden immediately. Missing days are not fabricated as rest.
weeklySchedule.motion: In-place grid-row reveal: 240ms opening, 160ms closing, cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1). Persistent completion circle/check: 120/180ms. Duration data changes: scaleX over 240ms with correct initial values. Reduced motion renders final states immediately.

portal-heading.purpose: Weekly Plan, Connect and Profile page titles below 640px; scoped extension of the existing serif hierarchy.

portal-heading-wide.purpose: Weekly Plan, Connect and Profile page titles from 640px.

motion.name: portal-state-transition
motion.purpose: Connect and Profile controls; removed under prefers-reduced-motion. Navigation uses 160ms color/background transitions and the shell uses 160ms opacity with 4px translation, disabled with useReducedMotion.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Existing Button's default variant; inherits the theme's CSS variables.
components.css: .ds-button { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; gap:8px; height:40px; padding:8px 16px; background:hsl(var(--primary)); color:hsl(var(--primary-foreground)); border:0; border-radius:calc(var(--radius) - 2px); font-family:"DM Sans",system-ui,sans-serif; font-size:14px; font-weight:500; line-height:20px; transition:background-color 0.15s; } .ds-button:hover { background:hsl(var(--primary) / 0.9); } .ds-button:focus-visible { outline:2px solid hsl(var(--ring)); outline-offset:2px; } .ds-button:disabled { pointer-events:none; opacity:0.5; }

components.name: Portal Profile Field
components.description: Scoped Profile field: 48px minimum height, the public Input's md radius and a foreground-derived control border retained for editing visibility. The portal-local override leaves the base Input unchanged.
components.css: .ds-portal-input { min-height:48px; width:100%; padding:8px 12px; border:1px solid hsl(var(--foreground) / 0.45); border-radius:calc(var(--radius) - 2px); background:hsl(var(--background)); color:hsl(var(--foreground)); font-family:"DM Sans",system-ui,sans-serif; font-size:16px; transition:background-color 160ms,border-color 160ms,color 160ms,box-shadow 160ms; } .ds-portal-input::placeholder { color:hsl(var(--foreground) / 0.7); opacity:1; } .ds-portal-input:hover:not(:disabled) { border-color:hsl(var(--foreground)); } .ds-portal-input:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--portal-primary, hsl(var(--primary))); outline-offset:4px; } .ds-portal-input:disabled { cursor:not-allowed; opacity:0.5; } @media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce) { .ds-portal-input { transition:none; } }

narrative.overview: Descriptive record of the React/Tailwind system.
